The Hydra Half Gallon Jug with time marker reminds you when it's time to drink water throughout the day. The one-touch flip lid keeps the drink surface covered and clean. Extra wide opening for easy filling, adding ice, and cleaning. Choose between the integrated carry loop or the soft-touch handle on the side for easy grab-and-go.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers like the water jug's appearance, particularly its color, and appreciate its size, noting it's not too huge or unwieldy. The handle receives positive feedback for being easy to hold, and customers find the 64-ounce capacity perfect for summer hydration. The value for money also gets mixed reactions, with some finding it great for the price while others say it's not worth the cost.

5 out of 5 stars
My Favorite Bottle After 3 Years!
I’ve had this water bottle for 3 years and still love it! My favorite things is that is had two giant handles, a locking lid, and is sooo easy to wash. I like that the straw comes off to wash and the mouthpiece isn’t hard plastic . All my times have rubbed off, but honestly I didn’t care much about them to begin with. This may be a dealbreaker for you if you like ice cold water since this version isn’t insulated but if you prefer room temp like me, it’s perfect. I also usually sit mine in the seat next to me in the car since it does not fit in the cup holders. I’ve seen reviews about leaking and have never dealt with that as long as I’ve had this bottle unless I put the cap on wrong. If it’s not tight enough it could leak, but this thing is durable and goes everywhere with me and gets tossed in my car, on my couch, work, walking, the bed, and mine does not leak. The cap also locks closed which I like too! Overall great water bottle!

  • Dan
    5 out of 5 stars
    Just works
    Reviewed in the United States on July 4, 2023
    Color: BubblegumSize: 64 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I do physical labor out in all temps and this is great for staying hydrated. Holds enough water to get me through a shift without having to refill constantly but isn't too huge or unwieldy. The handle which flips up at the top is super convenient compared to other bigger water bottles I've used. Streamlined design makes it very easy to tote around.

    Like all water bottles with an inset handle, cleaning it is kind of a pain, but I alternate baking soda/vinegar, hot water/soap, and salt/ice, and use a wire straw cleaner for the straw. I had issues with leaking at first, but then I figured out how to get the lid on tightly. If yours is leaking, fiddle with twisting the lid back and forth, check to make sure it's even all the way around, and turn the bottle upside down and shake it around to see if that fixed it. I haven't had any problems since doing this troubleshooting.

    Only negative is that the text (showing ounces and hours) wears off quickly, but I don't use those so I don't really care, and I've seen that happen consistently on bottles like these. If you really need them marked I would try stickers. I put stickers on mine and they stay on fine.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Exactly what I needed to stay hydrated.
    Reviewed in the United States on June 21, 2026
    Color: Halogen BlueSize: 64 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    This water bottle has quickly become one of my favorite purchases. The 64-ounce capacity is perfect because I can fill it once and know exactly how much water I’ve had throughout the day without constantly refilling smaller bottles.

    The handle makes it surprisingly easy to carry, even when it’s completely full. I also love the built-in straw and flip-top lid. It’s convenient to drink from, and the lid locks securely, so I don’t have to worry about leaks when carrying it around or placing it in a bag.

    The time markers are a great feature and help keep me on track with my hydration goals. Instead of guessing how much water I’ve had, I can easily see where I should be throughout the day.

    The bottle feels sturdy without being overly heavy, and the wide opening makes it easy to add ice and clean. The color is also attractive and looks even better in person.

    If you’re looking for a large, easy-to-carry water bottle that helps you stay hydrated and doesn’t leak, I highly recommend this one. It offers excellent value for the price and has made drinking enough water much easier.

    First of all, the lilac color is beautiful! It looks even better in person and makes the bottle feel a little more fun to use every day.

    I also really like the overall design. The straw stays covered when not in use, which is a nice touch, and it has both a side handle and a carry loop, so it’s easy to grab and carry even though it holds a full 64 oz. There’s also an option to lock the opening, which makes it feel much more secure for travel and helps prevent accidental leaks.

    The time markers are useful for keeping track of how much I’m drinking throughout the day, and honestly, having a bottle this large and convenient has definitely helped me drink more water.

    Practical, pretty, and thoughtfully designed. Definitely recommend!

  • Brenda Pane
    3 out of 5 stars
    It drips water on your face!
    Reviewed in the United States on March 28, 2024
    Color: Halogen BlueSize: 64 Ounces
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    The bottle is a nice size and so is the handle. The lid is tight and the lock feature is nice.

    BUT, do you see the tiny hole on the top of the lid? I guess it’s there to help the water come out of the spout. BUT it is positioned in such a way that when the bottle is tilted back for a drink, water comes out the top and runs all over my face! Ugh! I thought that I was doing something wrong, and if I’ve missed something and someone can tell me how to plug the hole, I’ll be glad to retract this review.

    Depending upon how full the bottle is, sometimes the little hole squirts water on my nose, sometimes in my eyes, sometimes on my cheeks or forehead.

    Yes, I should be able to turn the lid so the water doesn’t spit out, but it’s not possible. If I turn it upside down, not only is the hinged lid in my way but the water from the little hole dribbles down my chin. Turning it sideways doesn’t work because the main drinking spigot is mouth-shaped, and turning it on its side makes it uncomfortable and not very useful.

    So….the best way to drink from the bottle is with the lid off completely which sort of defeats the purpose of buying a portable bottle. Also, without the lid, there are ridges for the screw top which have hard edges and make it uncomfortable for drinking.

    So I’m not recommending this product at all.

About this Item

  • Motivational Tracking: Time markers help you stay on track throughout the day for maximum hydration
  • Leakproof Lid: One touch flip lid keeps drink surface covered while internal straw makes it easier to drink without spills
  • Easy to Clean: All parts are dishwasher safe for quick and easy cleaning
  • Travel Friendly: Ergonomic handles allow you to carry the jug with ease and comfort
  • Large Capacity: 64oz half gallon holds a day's worth of water for all day hydration

Product Description

The Hydra Half Gallon Jug with time marker reminds you when it's time to drink water throughout the day. The one-touch flip lid keeps the drink surface covered and clean. Extra wide opening for easy filling, adding ice, and cleaning. Choose between the integrated carry loop or the soft-touch handle on the side for easy grab-and-go.
